basis.cause: Native parent autonomously assigned broad verification and then planned review-until-PASS. Dynamic BGS did not schedule a fixed Review/Revision loop. This implementation does not remove the autonomous native strategy.

changes.result: On-demand byte lengths/SHA-256s for exact legacy prose/handoff operands, explicit missing markers, manifest normalized representation and absent runtime coverage. Default output stays compact. The aggregate hash, markers and legacy gates remain unchanged. requiredForAutonomousCurrent=false exposes the existing boundary; no automatic source/index rewriting.
changes.limitation: No historical source snapshot is invented; current fingerprints cannot locate a historical edit unless prior operands were retained. Does not force the Agent to stop investigating or repair its judgment.

changes.result: On-demand Node runtime, actual importable helper/pinned Playwright module URLs and relevant environment variable names. No environment values, capability URL or credential dump. Does not start a browser, install dependencies or execute a test/model.
changes.limitation: Discovery is simpler, but a Node script still requires valid active workspace capability and caller-selected interactions/observations. No user setting/hook access added.

core.skipped: Unrelated opt-in browser rendering test was not enabled. No whole-game acceptance inferred.

typecheck.command: bun run typecheck at integration repository root

validation.initialFailures: Sandbox local listeners were denied; rerun approved offline tests with loopback access. Package-local typecheck used the wrong root path configuration; fixed the new test array typing and root typecheck passed. A changed help-string assertion was updated to the actual optional diagnostic contract before final clean suite.

remaining: Wide autonomous semantic Review and review-until-PASS strategy remain unresolved; interface fixes are not proof of measured Token savings.
No native tool/delegation restriction or Review prompt was added. Deterministic checks and runtime viewing/listening/play remain necessary and distinct from LLM approval.
No paid model rerun or interrupted game continuation occurred. Previously stopped Run remains untouched.
Previously confirmed giant debug event display/runtime CPU stall and shared consumer adoption gaps were not in this narrow change.
sideEffects: Optional operand output is larger, so it is not returned by default or copied into the persistent production context.
Preview tool discovery includes an optional --client entry in tool metadata; no review responsibility instruction was appended.
Module locations are test tooling, not assets to commit into the delivered game.
